violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw shrimp was observed being stored on top of prepared fajitas
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHRIMP TO THE BOTTOM OF THE COOLER.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the ceiling tiles around the hood system heavily discolored
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO CLEAN CEILING PANELS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sinks by the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER WITH A NEW ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing signs posted at the two hand sinks in the kitchen (one by the 3 compartment sink and one by the packing station)
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS GAVE OWNERSHIP TWO HANDWASHING SIGNS TO POST.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of bulk spices and garlic were observed reused for the storage of various sauces and salsas.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. DISCARD MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS AND REPLACE WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS. MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS ARE NOT DESIGNED TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed holes and gaps in the ceiling tiles. Observed a missing ceiling tile above the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. REPAIR OR FILL HOLES TO PREVENT PESTS FROM ENTERING THE FACILITY.

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REFILLED THE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pulled chicken was observed at 49f; barbacoa sauce was observed at 47f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE CHICKEN AND SAUCE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed an unlabeled chemical spray bottle being stored under the register.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLE. ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES MUST BE LABELED.

violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for bulk spices were observed reused for the storage of sauces and marinades in the 2DR upright coolers.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. USE REUSABLE, PLASTIC PITCHERS OR DIFFERENT FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS TO STORE SAUCES AND MARINADES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the 1DR glass upright in the kitchen was observed at 55f using EHS’s thermometer
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE STORING TCS FOODS (ie: COOKED FOOD, CUT TOMATOES, SOUR CREAM, ETC.) IN THIS COOLER UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CALL A SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: No chlorine test kit was observed in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: BUY A CHLORINE TEST KIT. SEND EHS PROOF OF PURCHASE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: red beans, birria, beef/chicken burritos and pineapple sauce observed without date marking indicating production date.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Ensure all employees are marking the food storage containers or wrappings with the date the foods are made.
